messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Metering heartbeat degraded — token-emit service reporting ~8% fewer tokens for a subset of customers. Possible counting drift. Pager sent to on-call.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Checking emitter -> aggregator tails and recent heartbeat metrics. Any confirmed customer-facing overage or invoice hits?

billing-lead: We have 3 overage flags auto-generated this morning (suspicious spike). Two customers reported delayed invoices. Could be related to delayed emits.

sre-oncall: Quick checks running. Looking at emitter logs and redis ACK latencies.

ops-runner: Observed spike in ack latency between emitter and aggregator starting ~04:12 UTC, p50 -> 1s to ~4s. Might explain delayed window closure.

alyssa: I'll run a reconciliation against shadow-agg vs raw ingest for the 04:00-05:30 window and post deltas.

sre-oncall: Running local tail to see if tokens are being dropped:
```bash
sudo journalctl -u emitter.service -n 200 --no-pager | grep "emit" | tail -n 200
```

pagerduty-bot: @sre-oncall acknowledged incident INC-2026-1412.

sre-oncall: Flipping emitter to passthrough mode to avoid dedupe/drop heuristics while we triage. Do NOT restart the service.

alyssa: Post-passthrough quick reconciles: shadow-agg shows a +1.7% delta in token counts for the affected account set compared to the pre-pass-through window. Attaching short diffs in ops drive.

billing-lead: That matches the flagged accounts — looks like they were undercounted earlier and got overage flags because the system saw a sudden lower-than-expected baseline then a catch-up. We'll hold invoice churn until we reconcile.

product-ops: Which accounts are impacted and is there any customer-visible degradation?

billing-lead: Impacted accounts: Acme Inc (acct-234), BetaApps (acct-981). No invoices posted yet; flags only. CS will be notified for proactive comms.

ops-runner: Hypothesis: redis ACK latency caused emitter batching to close and clear KV dedupe windows prematurely; late messages were considered duplicates or dropped.

sre-oncall: Filed a PR for a conservative retry/dedupe window: https://github.com/redwood/emit/pull/421. Root cause looks like race between ack handler and batch flush on ack timeouts.

ops-runner: Kicked a canary hotfix to emitter at 04:38 UTC — enabling conservative retry, observing backlog drain. Monitoring token metrics and heartbeat.

alyssa: Full reconcile after canary: Acme +12,143 tokens, BetaApps +8,987 tokens for 04:00-05:00 UTC window. Will create backfill job ticket.

sre-oncall: Action items for now: 1) Keep emitter in passthrough while canary stabilizes; 2) Billing to pause invoice churn and prepare snapshots for corrected counts; 3) ENG to validate and promote hotfix or roll back if regressions.

billing-lead: Pausing churn. Notifying CS and legal where needed.

customer-success-bot: CS notified for impacted accounts with template "metering_investigation_v1".

sre-oncall: Closing pager for now. We'll run a full postmortem and schedule follow-ups (ENG-5405). Please add any missing notes here.

alyssa: Filed backfill pipeline job BE-1298 to re-emit reconciled deltas; attaching job link.

billing-lead: After backfill completes we'll re-run billing snapshots and confirm no erroneous charges. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Thanks — follow-up tasks: ENG-5405 (permanent fix), PM to review customer comms, and ops to validate alert thresholds to catch ACK latency earlier.
